effect.en: Raises the Defense and Special Defense of all friendly Pokémon with Plus or Minus by one stage.

flavor.ko: 자기장 조작으로 인해 특성 플러스와 마이너스의 방어, 특수방어가 오른다.
flavor.en: The user manipulates magnetic fields, which boosts the Defense and Sp. Def stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus Ability or the Minus Ability.
